Name: Irántxe
Location: Utiariti (Jesuit mission), Mato Grosso, Brazil; people from the rio Cravari
Remark: Collected by P. Adalberto Holanda Pereira SJ among the Irántxe (self-name Münkü per the author) settled at Utiariti, published 1964. Glottolog dialect Manoki (iran1264) = Irántxe proper of the Cravari; not the Münkü/Myky group (munk1243), contacted only in 1971.
